notes: The model number activates packaging and free-assignment semantics in the solver.
For M6-M8, policy.container_pool_size is a reference; pool_min/pool_max define the decision.
For M2/M4, satellite_id is the initial/reference assignment and is not fixed.
M5 fixes dispatch slots but does not enforce positive recovery in each slot; M6-M8 do. An ablation attributing differences only to released decisions must harmonize this rule.
M3 directly optimizes the same economic profile as M5-M8, with its original fixed single-batch calendar and full-Q pool.

demand_contract.goods_weight: Preserve the complete original customer goods weight.
demand_contract.assumption: Each customer demand fits one standard box; no bin-packing optimization.
